narrative.thesis: A reversible machine setup sheet for inspecting and changing a development toolchain.
narrative.visualWorld: Matte paper, ink rules, electric-blue calibration marks, coral warnings, and lime readiness signals.

motion.reducedMotion: Disable authored motion and smooth scrolling.

depth.default: Flat surfaces with tonal bands and rules.
depth.atmosphere: Faint circular calibration rings in the hero only.

components.primaryButton: Blue action button with white text, subtle radius, 1px boundary, and visible focus ring.
components.instrumentPanel: 2px ink boundary with dark status header, white manifest, blue command band, and lime no-change footer.
components.platformWorkbench: Ruled accessible tabs with one visible platform panel and a plain-text review command.
components.commandLedger: Rule-separated command rows with one blue featured row and a dark preview surface.
